SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(d2.d_date, d1.d_date) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `30 days`, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(d2.d_date, d1.d_date) > 30 AND DATEDIFF(d2.d_date, d1.d_date) <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `31-60 days`, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(d2.d_date, d1.d_date) > 60 AND DATEDIFF(d2.d_date, d1.d_date) <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `61-90 days`, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(d2.d_date, d1.d_date) > 90 AND DATEDIFF(d2.d_date, d1.d_date) <= 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `91-120 days`, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(d2.d_date, d1.d_date) > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `>120 days` 
FROM date_dim AS d2 
JOIN store_returns ON store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 
JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_ticket_number = store_returns.sr_ticket_number 
  AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = store_returns.sr_item_sk 
  AND store_sales.ss_customer_sk = store_returns.sr_customer_sk 
JOIN date_dim AS d1 ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk 
JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk 
WHERE d2.d_year = 2001 
  AND d2.d_moy = 8 
GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip 
ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip 
LIMIT 100
